intro.text: A fighter in Bilming whose powers mirror Wayne's, working alongside the Coinshot Dumad.
A member of the Set, a Bloodmaker and Slider who serves as Dumad's partner.

items.text: Getruda revealed herself during the failed sting in Bilming and fought Wayne, mimicking his accent and boasting of how she had prepared to beat him. Wayne pinned her with a wrestling hold her training had missed, and Dumad called her away as the gang retreated.

Getruda and Dumad ambushed Wax and Wayne underground, where she stabbed Wayne with a glass knife while he mocked her worsening accent. Wax shot her with an explosive Hemalurgist-killer round that tore away half her head, and she fled with Dumad through a street grate.

At the Shaw, Wax took Getruda on and battered her with a doorknob and other metal, breaking her bones. Her healing showed him where she kept her metalminds, so he blew off her arm with a hazekiller round to cut her off from them, then killed her with a shot to the head.

personality.text: Getruda is fixated on Wayne and practices his accent, though he thinks her attempts are poor.

items.text: Getruda is a Bloodmaker and a Slider, and while she has her metalminds she can heal even broken bones quickly.
